_comment: PG&E delivery and CleanPowerSF generation rates stored separately ($/kWh) so each can be updated independently. The app adds them together at runtime.

B6._note: Summer and winter delivery rates differ significantly. Super Off-Peak applies spring only (Mar-May). Verified against PG&E ELEC_SCHEDS_B-6.pdf (effective Mar 1 2026) and March 2026 paper bill.

delivery._source: PG&E Electric Delivery Charges — Schedule B-6 (ELEC_SCHEDS_B-6.pdf)

generation._source: CleanPowerSF Electric Generation Charges — Schedule B-6 (cleanpowersf.org/commercial-rate-tables)

BEV1._note: BEV1 rates are year-round with no seasonal variation. Super Off-Peak applies every day 9am-2pm year-round (unlike B-6 which is spring only). Peak capacity is billed via a subscription charge per 10kW block — this fixed cost is absorbed by the pro-rata multiplier when the paper bill total is entered. Delivery rates derived from PG&E total energy rates minus PG&E generation component. Verified against ELEC_SCHEDS_BEV.pdf (effective Mar 1 2026).

delivery._source: PG&E Electric Delivery Charges — Schedule BEV-1 (total energy rate minus generation component, ELEC_SCHEDS_BEV.pdf)

generation._source: CleanPowerSF Electric Generation Charges — Schedule B-EV-1 (cleanpowersf.org/commercial-rate-tables)
